package com.x;
public class BUnit extends BComponent {
  @NiagaraProperty(name="valveOut", type="BStatusBoolean", flags=Flags.SUMMARY)
  @NiagaraProperty(name="fanOut", type="BStatusBoolean", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
  @NiagaraProperty(name="pumpAlarm", type="BStatusBoolean", flags=Flags.TRANSIENT)
  void a(boolean tripped) {
    if (tripped) getValveOut().setValue(false);
    if (!tripped ) getFanOut().setValue( false );
    if (x && y) getValveOut().setValue(false);
    if (tripped)
      getValveOut().setValue(false);
    if ((tripped)) getPumpAlarm().setValue(false);
    if (tripped) { getFanOut().setValue(false); getValveOut().setValue(false); }
  }
}
